name: Eclipse
label: Snuff hit +1
text: Every Snuff intent deals +1 damage this round.

name: Smoke
label: Extra Plume
text: A Sootling Plume appears now on a legal tile; it rises this round. With neutrals off, nothing happens.

name: Long Shadows
label: Slow Snuff
text: Snuff steps and slides move 1 tile less (minimum 1). Leaps are unchanged.

name: Kindling
label: +1 Flame
text: Every seat gets +1 Flame at the start of its seat turn.

name: Bright Wings
label: Draw +1
text: Every seat draws 1 extra card at the start of its seat turn.
